blocking_reviews: Qualified medicinal-plant/clinical review of all twelve lessons
Current local plant identity, product registration and preparation protocol confirmation
Browser visual, keyboard and print-layout QA
timing_basis: Proposed 10-minute scope + ten eight-minute plant cards + 30-minute integrated station = 120 minutes, matching F38 two-hour allocation. Individual station times are an authoring adaptation.
source_adaptations: See evidence-review.json for the current PITAHC crosswalk and unresolved approval questions.
The ten plants are source-manual topics; the PITAHC online directory shows ten named entries but a conflicting “9 herbs” count.
No dose, ingestion, hot-water decoction, treatment replacement or botanical identification from a drawing is authorized.
Preparation return demonstration in F38 requires a qualified trainer and approved local protocol; this draft covers only dry consultation practice.
self_study_time: Not a replacement for facilitated training; additional observed practice may be required.
